spans.text: Why `proof` is a separate top-level field.
Evidence is raw — events, spans, hashes, transcripts. Proof is the

on that evidence: which gates passed, which invariants held, what the overall result was. A bundle reader must be able to answer "did this bundle prove what it claimed?" in O(1) — without re-deriving the answer from event traces. This is the response to GAP_REVIEW Gates A–F and to the central invariant (§0.4).
